        long long t = n;
        n = m;
        m = t;
    }

        else if (m == 3) cout << 4 << endl;
        else if (m == 7) cout << 12 << endl;
        else cout << m * 2 << endl;
    } else {
        if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) cout << (n * m - 1) << endl;
        else cout << (n * m) << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
